name: Deliver Value Fast
definition: We focus on what matters most to our customers and partners, embracing change and adapting quickly in a fast-paced industry.

rows.under: Builds the whole thing, and delivers value on the last day.
rows.justRight: Finds the slice that helps customers or partners this month, and ships that first.
rows.over: Ships slices so thin that nobody notices any of them, and the whole never arrives.

rows.under: Works on all of it, and finishes none of it.
rows.justRight: Names the one or two things that matter most to customers and partners, and lets the rest wait visibly.
rows.over: Cuts so narrowly that the things quietly holding the business up stop being maintained.

rows.situation: When the market moves under the plan
rows.under: Executes the plan, because it was agreed at the start of the year.
rows.justRight: Changes the plan quickly, and tells everyone what changed and why.
rows.over: Changes direction with every signal, and the team never finishes anything.

rows.situation: When the decision could wait for more data
rows.under: Waits. The window closes while the analysis runs.
rows.justRight: Decides on what would change the answer, ships, and learns from what happens.
rows.over: Moves before checking something cheap and obvious, and pays for it in rework.

rows.situation: When speed has started to hurt quality
rows.under: Keeps going, and lets partners absorb the defects.
rows.justRight: Keeps the pace and puts the check in the path, so speed does not depend on luck.
rows.over: Adds so much process after one bad release that nothing ships at all.

rows.situation: When the change lands on a partner
rows.under: Ships fast, and lets them find out.
rows.justRight: Moves fast on your side, and gives the partner the notice they need to move with you.
rows.over: Consults every partner on every change, and the pace drops to theirs.
